'''Faket''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Faket was inhabited by the [[Drivok]]s, a [[Species/Legends|species]] of psychic, [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Humanoid/Legends|Humanoids]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', indicated in [[March]] [[2023]] that Faket was validated for a future update of [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]].<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion 2023.jpg|creator=Jason Fry|date=2023-03-25}}</ref>
